advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 28/29 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.468 over 29 corners (27 understeer, 1 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Rears lock first: brake balance forward, decel diff lock down.
advice.evidence: median deficit R 0.44 vs F 0.26; 1/3 stops

advice.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 3 stops (1 both-axle, 0 front-first, 1 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.52) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
